```{python}
import os
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import squarify

# 한글 폰트 설정
plt.rcParams['font.family'] = 'NanumGothic'
plt.rcParams['axes.unicode_minus'] = False

# 가장 최근 수집된 CSV 파일 찾기
data_dir = Path("data") / "전자장비와기기"
csv_files = sorted(list(data_dir.glob("*.csv"))) if data_dir.exists() else []
latest_csv = csv_files[-1] if csv_files else None
trade_date = latest_csv.stem if latest_csv else "N/A"

# 데이터 로드
df = pd.read_csv(latest_csv) if latest_csv else pd.DataFrame()

# 컬럼명 유연하게 매칭 및 정제
price_col = "현재가(종가)" if "현재가(종가)" in df.columns else "현재가"
name_col = "종목명" if "종목명" in df.columns else (df.columns[0] if not df.empty else "")
change_col = next((c for c in ["등락률(%)", "등락률"] if c in df.columns), None)

if not df.empty and name_col in df.columns and price_col in df.columns:
    df['cleaned_price'] = pd.to_numeric(df[price_col].astype(str).str.replace(",", ""), errors="coerce")

if not df.empty and change_col:
    df['cleaned_change'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df[change_col].astype(str).str.replace("%", "").str.replace("+", "").str.replace(",", ""), 
        errors="coerce"
    )

#| content: valuebox
#| title: "데이터 기준일"
dict(
    icon = "calendar-event",
    color = "primary",
    value = trade_date
)

#| content: valuebox
#| title: "총 수집 종목 수"
dict(
    icon = "building",
    color = "info",
    value = f"{len(df)}개"
)

#| content: valuebox
#| title: "업종 평균 등락률"
avg_change = df['cleaned_change'].mean() if not df.empty and 'cleaned_change' in df.columns else 0.0
avg_change = 0.0 if pd.isna(avg_change) else avg_change
color_val = "danger" if avg_change > 0 else ("info" if avg_change < 0 else "secondary")
icon_val = "graph-up-arrow" if avg_change > 0 else "graph-down-arrow"
dict(
    icon = icon_val,
    color = color_val,
    value = f"{avg_change:+.2f}%"
)

#| title: "전체 종목 현재가 현황"
if not df.empty and 'cleaned_price' in df.columns:
    df_sorted = df.dropna(subset=['cleaned_price']).sort_values(by='cleaned_price', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.5))
    ax.bar(df_sorted[name_col], df_sorted['cleaned_price'], color="skyblue")
    ax.set_ylabel("현재가 (원)")
    plt.xticks(rotation=45, ha="right", fontsize=9)
    plt.tight_layout()
    fig
    plt.close(fig)

#| title: "종목별 등락률(%) 현황"
if not df.empty and 'cleaned_change' in df.columns:
    df_change = df.dropna(subset=['cleaned_change']).sort_values(by='cleaned_change', ascending=True)
    colors = ['#d9534f' if x > 0 else ('#5bc0de' if x < 0 else '#999999') for x in df_change['cleaned_change']]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.5))
    ax.barh(df_change[name_col], df_change['cleaned_change'], color=colors)
    ax.axvline(0, color='gray', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8)
    ax.set_xlabel("등락률 (%)")
    plt.tight_layout()
    fig
    plt.close(fig)

#| title: "상세 종목 데이터 테이블"
display_cols = [c for c in ["종목명", "종목코드", price_col, "등락률(%)", "거래량"] if c in df.columns]
if not df.empty:
    from IPython.display import HTML
    HTML(df[display_cols].to_html(index=False, classes="table table-striped table-hover align-middle", border=0))

#| title: "종목별 규모 비중 (트리맵)"
if not df.empty and 'cleaned_price' in df.columns:
    df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['cleaned_price']).sort_values(by='cleaned_price', ascending=False)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 4.5))
    try:
        labels = [f"{row[name_col]}\n({int(row['cleaned_price']):,}원)" for _, row in df_clean.iterrows()]
        squarify.plot(
            sizes=df_clean['cleaned_price'], 
            label=labels, 
            alpha=0.7, 
            ax=ax, 
            text_kwargs={'fontsize': 8}
        )
        ax.axis('off')
    except Exception as e:
        ax.text(0.5, 0.5, f"트리맵 생성 오류: {e}", ha='center', va='center')
    plt.tight_layout()
    fig
    plt.close(fig)
